description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different models in terms of Recall@50 and NDCG@50 across five evaluation points, with the left y-axis representing Recall@50 and the right y-axis representing NDCG@50. The x-axis ranges from 1 to 5, with tick marks at each integer value. The green solid line with circular markers, labeled "Recall@50 (Ours)", shows a steady increase in Recall@50 from approximately 0.35 at x=1 to 0.50 at x=5. The green dotted line, labeled "Recall@50 (ReFICR)", remains constant at approximately 0.45 across all x-values. The blue solid line with square markers, labeled "NDCG@50 (Ours)", increases from approximately 0.16 at x=1 to 0.18 at x=5. The blue dotted line, labeled "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)", remains constant at approximately 0.16 across all x-values. The NDCG@50 values are plotted on the right y-axis, which ranges from 0.15 to 0.22, with the corresponding values for the blue lines aligning with this scale.
